title: Questo qui, quello là: le foto di famiglia
summary: questo vs quello, demonstrative agreement, and showing photos of family and places

blocks.title: questo — right here
blocks.body: *questo* means 'this' — pointing at something close. It agrees like a regular -o adjective: **questo** (m. sing.), **questa** (f. sing.), **questi** (m. pl.), **queste** (f. pl.). *Questo libro* (this book), *questa foto* (this photo).
blocks.callout: Showing someone a photo? questa foto è… is your go-to opener.

blocks.title: quello — over there
blocks.body: *quello* means 'that' — pointing at something farther away. It changes shape just like *il/lo/la* does, depending on what follows: **quel** (before most masc. sing. nouns), **quello** (before masc. sing. s+consonant/z), **quella** (fem. sing.), **quei** (masc. pl.), **quegli** (masc. pl. before vowel/s+consonant), **quelle** (fem. pl.).
blocks.callout: Same pattern as il/lo/la — if you know the article, you basically know quello.

blocks.title: questo vs quello — close vs far

pairs.note: questo points at what's near you; quello points at what's farther away.

blocks.prompt: Your cousins are in a photo across the room. How do you say 'those kids'?
blocks.explain: bambini is masculine plural and it's far away, so quello becomes quei: quei bambini.

blocks.prompt: Which is correct for 'that uncle' (zio, across the room)?
blocks.explain: zio starts with the s+consonant-like z pattern, so quello keeps its full form — same rule as lo zio.

blocks.hint: casa is feminine singular — questo agrees.
blocks.explain: *Questa casa* — casa is feminine, so questo becomes questa.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type the whole line.

blocks.scene: You show Giulia old family photos on your phone

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Che belle foto! Chi è questo?

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Questo è mio nonno, e questa è mia nonna.
lines.en: This is my grandfather, and this is my grandmother.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: E quella donna, vicino a loro?
lines.en: And that woman, next to them?

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Quella è mia zia, la sorella di mia madre.
lines.en: That's my aunt, my mother's sister.
lines.spotlight: sorella takes la here because it's modified by di mia madre — the no-article rule is only for a plain, unmodified family word.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.en: What a big family! Really lovely photo.

blocks.prompt: Imagine showing a friend three photos. Write one line for each using questo/questa or quello/quella/quei/quelle.
